verdict: Alphabet grew revenue 15% to $88.3B as Google Cloud jumped 35% and Search rose 12% — and a $1.8B investment gain helped lift profit to $26.3B.

segments.name: Google Services
segments.note: Search, YouTube, subscriptions and devices — Search & other revenue rose 12% to $49.4B and YouTube ads 12% to $8.9B.

segments.name: Google Cloud
segments.note: Cloud computing rented to companies — up 35%, and its operating profit jumped to $1.9B from $0.3B a year ago.

segments.name: Other Bets
segments.note: Moonshot projects such as Waymo — small revenue and a $1.1B operating loss this quarter.

segments.name: Hedging gains
segments.note: Gains from currency hedging that sit outside the three businesses.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Engineers and researchers building the products and AI models.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling ads and devices, and promoting the products.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — legal, finance and facilities.

otherDetail: Interest income $1,243M and a $1,821M gain on equity investments, plus smaller gains on debt securities, less interest expense and other items, net.
follow100Note: Other income adds $3.61 of every $100 — most of it a $1.8B paper gain on investments, not money from customers. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Cloud is compounding
takeaways.text: Google Cloud revenue jumped 35% to $11.4B, and its operating profit leapt to $1.9B from just $0.3B a year ago — the cloud has become a real second engine, not just a growth story.

takeaways.title: Search still pays for everything
takeaways.text: Search & other revenue rose 12% to $49.4B and YouTube ads grew 12% to $8.9B — the advertising core still supplies the great bulk of Alphabet's money.

takeaways.title: Profit rose 34%
takeaways.text: Net income rose 34% to $26.3B, helped by a $1.8B paper gain on equity investments inside other income; free cash flow was $17.6B in the quarter.

oneTimers: A $1.8B gain on equity investments — paper gains on stakes Alphabet holds — sits inside the $3.2B of other income and flatters net income; it is not revenue from customers.
